scenes.name: news
scenes.text:
What’s new
November 28, 2026
Classes, Rush and new match modes

Cartridge-Strike 3 · Build aec199fd40e8

Choose your class before deploying in Solo. Build forward speed to Rush, then crouch to slide. Touch players can use the stick edge or a dedicated Run button.

Play Free-for-All for individual points, or contest capture zones in Domination. Open Classes to inspect your equipment and Outfits to change your operator.

November 27, 2026
New match menus

Choose Solo or With friends from Play. Quick join takes you directly to the family room. Your saved characters are available in Solo setup.

Edit touch layoutReset look settings

Push the stick past its ring to run. Press Crouch while running to slide. Auto-fire follows a visible target. Tap Aim to toggle, or hold it for temporary aim. Double-tap the look area to toggle aim. Hold Throw to prepare a grenade and release to throw.

Gamepad: move with the left stick, look with the right, press L3 to run, B to crouch, LT to aim and RT to fire. Start pauses. Use the D-pad and A to navigate menus. Bonus buttons follow the bindings above.
